## Interactions & Behaviors

- **Clicking "All People"** in left sidebar: loads the full unfiltered people list (current state)
- **Clicking a Collection or Smart List** in left sidebar: filters the main list to that saved segment; badge count updates the result count
- **Clicking "All People" sort item** [INFERRED]: keeps the full 874-person list; query param changes to reflect sort
- **Clicking a column header** (e.g., "Name", "Lead Score"): toggles sort ascending/descending on that column; updates URL sort param [INFERRED]
- **Clicking "↓" on Last Activity:** currently active sort; clicking would toggle to ascending
- **Clicking "≡ Columns ↓":** opens a dropdown panel to check/uncheck which columns are visible in the table [INFERRED]
- **Clicking "Out of State Home ... ↓":** opens a dropdown of named column presets; selecting a different preset changes the visible column set [INFERRED]
- **Clicking "⊘ Filters":** toggles the right-side filter panel open/closed (panel currently visible)
- **Typing in "Add a filter":** opens a filter-type picker to add criteria (e.g., by tag, stage, source, lead score range, date range, etc.) [INFERRED]
- **Clicking a contact row:** navigates to the Contact Detail / Person Record view for that contact [INFERRED]
- **Clicking the SMS/WhatsApp icon on a phone number:** opens a quick-compose text message inline or in a SMS panel [INFERRED]
- **Clicking the call icon on a phone number:** initiates a call via the FUB dialer or logs a call [INFERRED]
- **Clicking an email address icon:** opens the email compose panel (this is likely what triggered the currently visible compose panel)
- **Clicking "+ New List":** opens a dialog or inline form to create a new Smart List or Collection [INFERRED]
- **Clicking "How Smart Lists work":** opens a help article, tooltip, or onboarding overlay explaining Smart Lists [INFERRED]
- **Compose panel — Attachments:** opens a file picker to attach files to the email [INFERRED]
- **Compose panel — Templates:** opens a template library picker to insert a saved email template [INFERRED]
- **Compose panel — Send Email button:** sends the composed email to the recipient; logs the email in the contact's timeline [INFERRED]
- **Compose panel — close (×):** closes the compose panel without sending; returns to list view [INFERRED]
- **View-toggle icons** (after "874 people"): switch between list/table view, card/grid view, and possibly map view [INFERRED]
- **Hovering a row:** likely reveals a checkbox for bulk selection on the left; may also reveal additional quick-action icons [INFERRED]
- **Selecting multiple rows via checkbox:** triggers a bulk-action bar at top with options like "Tag", "Assign Agent", "Add to Stage", "Send Email to All", "Delete", etc. [INFERRED]

## Data Model Signals

**Entities:**

1. **Person / Contact**
   - `id` (integer or UUID)
   - `name` (string — first + last, or full trust/entity name)
   - `type` / `sub_label` (enum: "Prospect", "Farm", "Expired Listing", possibly "Buyer", "Seller", "Past Client", etc.)
   - `lead_score` (integer, likely 1–10)
   - `assigned_agent_id` (FK to Agent/User)
   - `last_visit_date` (datetime — website visit)
   - `last_activity_date` (datetime — sort field)
   - `last_activity_description` (string — truncated, e.g., "Viewed [page title]")
   - `phone` (string, E.164 or formatted)
   - `email` (string)
   - `tags` (many-to-many — e.g., "Farm", "TCPA", "Absentee Owner")
   - `source` (string)
   - `stage` (string)

2. **Agent / User**
   - `id`, `name`, `email`, `avatar_url`, `role`, `phone`
   - `signature_html` (rich-text email signature)

3. **Collection** (manual grouping, like a folder)
   - `id`, `name`, `type: 'collection'`, `contact_count`
   - Examples: Pipeline, Hot/Weekly, Warm/Bi-Weekly, Coldish-Monthly, etc.

4. **Smart List** (dynamic, rule-based filter saved as a named list)
   - `id`, `name`, `type: 'smart_list'`, `rules` (jsonb), `contact_count`
   - Examples: All Recent Online Activity (637), TCPA Litigators – Hard Stop (135)

5. **Column Preset / Saved View**
   - `id`, `name`, `columns` (ordered array of column definitions)
   - Example: "Out of State Home ..." (custom column set)

6. **Activity / Timeline Event**
   - `type` (enum: "page_view", "email_sent", "call_logged", "text_sent", "note", "stage_change", "automation", etc.)
   - `description` (string — "Viewed Central Oregon Real Estate Experts in B…")
   - `contact_id` (FK)
   - `occurred_at` (datetime)

7. **Email Message**
   - `to` (string)
   - `cc`, `bcc` (strings, optional)
   - `subject` (string)
   - `body_html` (rich text)
   - `template_id` (FK, optional)
   - `attachments` (array)
   - `sent_at` (datetime)
   - `contact_id` (FK)

8. **Email Template**
   - `id`, `name`, `subject`, `body_html`

9. **Email Signature**
   - Stored per-user/agent; includes name, title, company, phones, URLs, legal disclaimer, headshot image

**Enum values revealed:**
- Contact sub-labels/types: `Prospect`, `Farm`, `Expired Listing`
- Sort fields: `lastLeadActivity` (URL param)
- Smart list filter categories: `TCPA` compliance, `Absentee Owners`, `Expirings`, `Recent Online Activity`, `FSBO`, `Realtors`

```
    </ContentBody>
  </MainContent>

  {/* Compose panel overlaid on content area */}
  <EmailComposePanel position="inline-right">
    <RecipientField label="To:" />
    <CcBccToggle label="CC BCC →" />
    <SubjectField label="Subject:" />
    <RichTextToolbar>
      <ToolbarButton icon="bold" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="italic" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="underline" />
      {/* … additional formatting buttons */}
    </RichTextToolbar>
    <EmailBodyEditor defaultValue={currentUser.emailSignatureHtml} />
    <ComposeFooter>
      <AttachmentsButton />
      <TemplatesButton />
      <SendEmailButton variant="primary">Send Email</SendEmailButton>
      <EmojiPickerButton />
    </ComposeFooter>
  </EmailComposePanel>
</AppShell>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic Notes

1. **Column presets are saved per-user or per-account:** The "Out of State Home ..." column preset is a named configuration of which columns to show for a particular use case (e.g., tracking out-of-state leads). This is separate from Smart List filters — it only controls column visibility, not row filtering.

2. **Sort is URL-driven:** The `?sort=lastLeadActivity` query param drives the sort, meaning the sort state is shareable and bookmarkable. The UI should sync sort state to the URL.

3. **"Last Activity" vs "Last Visit":** These are distinct data points. "Last Visit" = when the contact last visited the tracked website (from pixel/UTM). "Last Activity" = the most recent FUB activity of any type (visit, email, call, text, stage change, etc.) and displays its human-readable description.

4. **Email compose as inline panel (not modal):** The compose email panel appears to be a side panel that overlays the contact list from the right, rather than a full-screen modal. This keeps the contact list visible in the background, giving context of which contact is being emailed. The panel may be triggered by clicking an email action icon on a row.

5. **Contact sub-labels ("Farm", "Prospect", "Expired Listing"):** These appear to be FUB **stages** or **lead types** displayed as a sub-label beneath the contact name. They correspond to segmentation categories for the contact.

6. **The "TCPA Litigators – Hard Stop" smart list (135 contacts):** This is a compliance list. The "Hard Stop" naming convention suggests a programmatic block on texting/calling these contacts. Any bulk action should check membership in this list before executing.

7. **Badge counts on sidebar items are live:** The counts (637, 121, 593, 135, etc.) reflect real-time or near-real-time counts of contacts matching the Smart List rules. They should be fetched via API and may auto-refresh.

8. **"12K" badge on Neighborhoods:** The "K" suffix indicates abbreviated large numbers. Format as `12K` not `12,000` for sidebar badges.

9. **Signature pre-population:** The email compose panel pre-populates with the logged-in agent's HTML signature automatically. The signature includes: name, title, company, phone, email, URL, tagline, review link, agency disclosure link, license number, EHO disclaimer, and a non-solicitation notice. Also includes a headshot image.

10. **"Manage" link at bottom of Smart Lists:** This navigates to a Smart Lists management screen where lists can be created, edited, reordered, and deleted. It is a navigation link, not a button.

11. **Last Activity descriptions are website page views** for the visible rows: "Viewed Central Oregon Real Estate Experts in B…" — this is a tracked page view event captured by FUB's lead tracking pixel embedded on the Ryan Realty website. The truncation at "B…" suggests the page title or URL continues beyond the column width.

12. **The compose panel is triggered from a row action** [INFERRED]: The most likely trigger is clicking an email icon in the Email column of a contact row, which opens the compose panel pre-addressed to that contact's email.
